card.name: The word now after until or here
card.fires_on: The word "now" when it follows "until", "up until", "here", "before" or "and", as in "until now" or "here now was". It marks a contrast between the past and the present.

modes.label: until now
modes.description: "now" right after "until" or "up until", describing something that was true only up to the present.
modes.example: Until<< now>>, no study has offered conclusive proof that

modes.label: here/and now
modes.description: "now" after "here" or "and" at the start of a clause, introducing something new or present.
modes.example: Here<< now>> was a serologic, or blood marker
